prompt:
Our drug discovery team has a batch compound screening pipeline that apparently crashed mid-run and left things in a broken state. The pipeline is for the task slug 'compound-screen-2024'. Before the crash, it had processed 20 compounds successfully and 1 failure. We now have 30 new compounds to add to the processing queue — they're listed in the file at data/raw/compounds/new_batch_2024.json.

We need someone to:
1. Get the system configured and ready to run (there's an example configuration file somewhere that needs to be adapted for this machine — use batch size 10, lock timeout 15 minutes, schedule every 5 minutes in UTC, sequential delivery mode, and agent ID 'pharma-screener-01').
2. Recover the pipeline from its crashed state so it can run again without errors.
3. Queue up all 30 new compounds so they're ready for the next processing run, making sure each one can be uniquely identified to avoid duplicates.
4. Verify the system reports a healthy status for the 'compound-screen-2024' task.

Please make sure the existing history of completed and failed compounds is not lost.
